short_description_for_model: Static security scanner for MCP servers, AI skills and AI agents. OWASP MCP Top 10 + OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 aligned, 235 rule categories, offline, never executes the configuration it scans.
description_for_human: AIShield 是 Agent 原生的 AI 工具安全扫描器与可信工具认证基础设施。扫描 MCP server、AI skill、Agent 配置中的工具投毒、Prompt 注入、凭据泄漏、沙箱误配置与供应链风险；235 类 MCP 规则 / 241 类 skill 规则，对齐 OWASP MCP Top 10 与 OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (ASI01-ASI10)。本地优先、零依赖、可离线运行，扫描过程绝不执行被扫配置。
description_for_model: AIShield scans MCP servers, AI skills and AI agents for tool poisoning, prompt injection, credential leakage, sandbox misconfiguration, rug pulls, slopsquatting, identity-layer issues (unsigned AgentCard, over-broad scopes) and network-layer exposure (unauthenticated agent endpoints, private resources reachable from the public internet). It runs fully offline on the user's machine, auto-discovers MCP configuration across 14 client surfaces, and audits every configured server WITHOUT spawning it - reading tools/list requires starting the server, and an MCP command is arbitrary code. Use it as a CI security gate, as an MCP server (npx aishield-mcp-server), or through the REST API at https://aishield.tools/api/v1. Machine-readable discovery assets: /openapi.json, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /agent-discovery.json, /.well-known/agent-card.json, /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json, /.well-known/security.txt.

endpoints.description: Service status, version, rules count and rules breakdown (static / generated / radar).
Scan an MCP server / AI skill / agent configuration and return findings aligned with OWASP MCP Top 10 and OWASP Agentic AI Top 10.
Detect prompt injection, jailbreak and information-theft patterns in Chinese and English.
Detect banned and sensitive words for 6 Chinese content platforms, with legal references and replacement suggestions.
MCP-protocol security audit of a tool repository, including rug-pull and supply-chain risk.
Register an agent identity and receive a Trust Score attestation (aishield-trust/v1).
One-command agent onboarding: install instructions, API key and DID identity setup.

usage_policy: Free for local scanning of your own tools and open-source repositories. The open-source local edition runs entirely on the user's machine and never sends scanned content to a cloud service. Cloud API usage is rate-limited per IP; see https://aishield.tools/pricing for paid tiers.
category_id_note: The owasp_category values ASI01-ASI10 are AIShield's INTERNAL category IDs, not the official OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications (2026) identifiers. Only ASI01/ASI02/ASI03 coincide. Internal ASI04 (memory poisoning) = official ASI06 Memory & Context Poisoning; official ASI04 = Agentic Supply Chain. Internal ASI09 (cascading failure) = official ASI08. Official ASI05 (Unexpected Code Execution) has no dedicated internal category. The field carries TWO namespaces: MCP01-MCP10 are official OWASP MCP Top 10 codes; ASI01-ASI10 are AIShield internal. Most Agentic scanners emit MCP0x - of the 11 Agentic modules only scanner/memory_integrity_scan.py emits an internal ASI code (ASI04) - so filtering reports on ASI0x misses the majority of Agentic findings. Machine-readable crosswalk: the internal_to_owasp_agentic key returned by compliance_summary(). Source of truth: scanner/compliance.py (INTERNAL_ASI_TO_OWASP, OWASP_AGENTIC_2026, OWASP_AGENTIC_THREATS T1-T17).
